title: GLM-5.2 agentic benchmark 接近 Anthropic
author: AaronRossPreIPO
cached_full_text: BREAKING: A Chinese open-source model is now landing within roughly 1% of Anthropic's best on a key agentic benchmark — at about one-fifth the cost. Zhipu AI (now Z.ai) released GLM-5.2 under a permissive open-weight license: 750B parameters, a 1M-token [context window].
